goal: Beat VTI after realistic costs. The single change versus twelve_seven_v1 is the entry halt.
hypothesis: Ranking by the same 12-to-7 adjusted return, with the 15% entry halt re-armed after 21 exchange sessions instead of left on for the rest of the window, beats a VTI hold on both disjoint 365-day windows at 5 and 10 bps per side. It also beats the already published sticky 12-to-7 book on return, without a drawdown more than 2.0 percentage points worse than that sticky book.
one_knob: Entry halt only. Rank, eligibility, stops, hold, sizing, sleeve, name cap, fills, costs, windows, panel, and the 7-minute quote cap stay as in twelve_seven_v1.

halt.trigger: Book equity at the close, or at the next open before a buy, at or below peak * (1 - 0.15). Same 15% level as the sticky rule.
halt.sticky_rule_being_replaced: entry_halt stays true for the rest of the window. Peak is not reset.
halt.why_not_drawdown_recovery: Once the book is in cash, equity is flat, so drawdown from the old peak never heals. A re-arm-when-recovered rule would match the sticky halt on that path. The frozen rule is a clock, not a price recovery.
halt.clock: Re-arm on the close where session_index - halt_index >= 21. The halt session starts the count. A later breach does not push the clock out. Entries can be decided on the re-arm close and filled the next open.
halt.peak_reset: On re-arm, peak becomes that close's equity. Without the reset the 15% check would halt again the same day. This allows another 15% loss from the new peak. That looser budget is part of this one rule.
halt.exits: Stops, trails, time exits, and the end-of-window liquidation still run while entries are halted.
halt.daily_loss: The 2% daily-loss skip is unchanged and is not this knob.
halt.applies_to: Both books in this run, so the paired extension book uses the same halt. The pass baseline for the knob is the published sticky 12-to-7 result, not the paired book.

primary_benchmark: VTI buy and hold, same window, same per-side slippage
one_knob_baseline: learner in results_12_7.json (12-to-7 rank, sticky 15% halt)
also_reported: extension rank with this same recovering halt
equal-weight hold of the included names
universe: symbols_included from the local_expectancy results. SPCX stays out.

pass_rule.reason_promotion_stays_false: Peak reset loosens the 15% budget. Daily clock, survivorship, and quote age 0 on historical opens remain. A numerical pass does not change a live or Medium book.
